metadata.description: The AI and communication layer for running the business, with Odoo as the system of record: one setup for every role, governed outbound email, a live governance demo, business administration over Odoo, and the admin control plane.

plugins.name: systemprompt-commons
plugins.description: What every role gets: the one workspace setup skill, the shared brand skill, and outbound email that a second human approves before it leaves.

plugins.name: systemprompt-demo
plugins.description: Trip the governance pipeline on purpose and watch it answer: a held call, a refused secret, a blocked destructive tool, and the lead-to-factsheet-to-email arc that ends in a held send.

plugins.name: systemprompt-admin
plugins.description: Admin-only: business administration over Odoo (what has been happening, leads that need a status) plus the control plane — operate the stack, prove governance live, read back what every task cost. Ships the systemprompt CLI server and seven live dashboards.
